item.title: Cold case: Trial date set in 1993 abduction, murder of 12-year-old Jennifer Odom
item.description: Accused killer Jeffrey Crum learned in court Friday that he will stand trial in August for the 1993 rape and murder of 12-year-old Jennifer Odom.

item.title: American family lands in Tampa after being rescued from cartel violence in Mexico
item.description: The Acosta family was visiting other members of their extended family when violence broke out last weekend, stemming from the killing of drug cartel leader "El Mencho."

item.title: Former Florida officer who raped, murdered 11-year-old set to be executed
